name: Tom L Forest

positions.statement: Forest says he will work to protect Oregonians from federal overreach such as ICE, vote-by-mail suppression and tax breaks for the rich.

positions.statement: Forest says he is opposed to bills that raise utility rates and give tax breaks to data centers and big tech in North Plains.
positions.excerpt: raise utility rates and give hundreds of millions of dollars in tax breaks for data centers and big tech in North Plains (SB1586). I'm a big "No" to all that.

positions.statement: Forest says communities can balance agricultural and natural resource economies with new industries.
